name: thott-bot
description: Everything about World of Warcraft: Forever in your AI, from every change to live auction prices.

interface.longDescription:
Everything about World of Warcraft: Forever, in the chat app you already use. Ask about anything you'd normally look up, in your own words.

Why thott.bot:
- Connected. Quests, items, recipes, NPCs and maps are linked: what a quest needs, where that item drops, where you turn it in, what it crafts. Your AI gets the whole picture in one place.
- Kept current. Every new build, patch and hotfix reaches thott.bot usually within minutes of landing, even the silent ones.
- Straight from Blizzard. Game facts come from Blizzard's own files and posts. Community guides are labeled as such.

What it knows:
- Your characters: link Battle.net and your AI knows the characters you actually play, their gear, talents, quests and more, updated every time you log out.
- Patch notes and changes: every build and hotfix, and exactly what each changed.
- Quests and leveling: every quest, its chain, route and rewards, and leveling guides.
- Talents and builds: the builds players run right now, counted daily from millions of real characters at every level, every spec's talent pick rates, and every talent change.
- Spells and abilities: every spell and ability, and every change to each.
- Classes and races: every class, race and racial, and what Forever changed for each.
- Items and gear: every item and item set, where it drops and who sells it.
- Crafting and professions: every profession, recipe and reagent, what each reagent makes, and profession leveling guides.
- Auction house: live prices on every WoW Forever auction house, hourly.
- The world: zones, maps, flight paths, dungeons, raids and bosses, battlegrounds.
- Collections: mounts, pets, toys, achievements, reputations and holidays.
- Interface and addons: every setting, key binding and chat command, the addon API and banned addons.
- Blizzard news: news and developer posts (blue posts) from the official forums.

In ChatGPT, ask to see it: your characters' sheets with the gear and stats they logged out with, the game's own tooltips, clickable talent trees, quest chains, maps and before-and-after cards.

For every WoW Forever player, from first-timers to theorycrafters and addon developers.

Limitations: thott.bot covers World of Warcraft: Forever only, not retail WoW or other Classic versions. It doesn't yet hold boss strategy, stat priorities or complete loot tables, and we're adding more all the time. Connecting needs a thott.bot account (sign in with Discord, Google or email).

thott.bot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment, Wowhead, ZAM or the original Thottbot.
capabilities: Get personalized answers about the live characters you play
Look up any quest, item, spell, talent or NPC
See what every build and hotfix changed
Find the talent builds players run right now
Follow quest chains and leveling guides
Show the game's own tooltips, talent trees and maps
Read Blizzard's news and developer posts
defaultPrompt: Did Arcane Blast just get nerfed in WoW Forever?
I play a Paladin. What changed for me in WoW Forever this week?
What's the most popular Fire Mage build in WoW Forever right now?

positive.description: A game fact from the current Forever game files: an ability's effect, cost and requirements.
positive.prompt: What does the Warrior ability Mortal Strike do in WoW Forever, and what do I need to use it?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search for Mortal Strike and may fetch the entry. Answers that Mortal Strike is an Arms talent (1 rank, unlocked after 30 points in Arms) that deals weapon damage plus a bonus and reduces healing on the target by 50% for 10 seconds, costs 30 rage with a 6 second cooldown, and needs a melee weapon. Later ranks are learned from level 48.

positive.description: What Forever changed from Classic for one class.
positive.prompt: What did WoW Forever change for Warriors compared to Classic?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls changes with since "classic" and class Warrior. Lists Forever's differences from Classic Era: for example Victory Rush is a new ability at level 20, Tactical Mastery is trained instead of a talent, Berserker Rage is learned at 30 instead of 32, plus changed values and talent tree differences.

positive.description: The builds players run, counted from real characters, drawn as an interactive talent tree.
positive.prompt: Show me the most popular Fire Mage build in WoW Forever.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show with the popular Fire Mage builds (it may search first). Displays the top Fire builds on the Mage talent trees, each with the share of characters running it and Blizzard named as the source, and summarizes the top build's key talents (such as Ignite, Critical Mass and Pyroblast).

positive.prompt: What new race and class combinations are there in WoW Forever?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search and cites Blizzard's 2026-09-22 article "Create the Hero You Want to Be in World of Warcraft: Forever" with its date and link: new combinations include Orc Mages, Troll Warlocks, Undead Paladins, Human Hunters, Gnome Priests and Dwarf Shamans, plus the new Skyborne race.

positive.description: Addon development against the Forever client's own API.
positive.prompt: I'm writing a WoW Forever addon. Which API function tells me whether the player is in combat, and how do I call it?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search and may fetch the API entry. Answers with UnitAffectingCombat(unit), called as UnitAffectingCombat("player"), which returns whether the unit is in combat, from the Forever client's Unit API.
